column1: # perm-model.tsv: the one permission model. fix-perms, setup_agent.sh, build_app and
# deploy-orchestration read it through perm-lib.sh (perm_apply / perm_verify / perm_umask);
# nothing else decides an owner, group, mode or umask.
#   area     name used by the tools
#   owner    '-' keep, 'root', or a project.config key (primary_user, coder_user, ...)
#   group    '-' keep, 'root', or a project.config key (code_group, shared_group, sandbox_group)
#   dir      directory mode: '-' keep, absolute octal (2770), or chmod symbolic (u+rwx,g+rwxs,o+rx)
#   file     regular-file mode, same forms; X = execute only where some x bit is already set
#   umask    umask for processes that create files there ('-' = nobody creates files there)
#   what     the paths, and the boundaries a recursive pass never crosses
# A recursive pass over one area always prunes every other area's root that lies inside it
# (other worktrees from 'git worktree list', sandbox_dir, the shared homes, .git).

column8: one worktree's files (a path from git worktree list); prunes .git and nested areas
TODO.md and project-facts.md in a worktree
scripts run by path (build_app, deploy, *.sh, ...) at a worktree's top level
active hooks (not *.sample) in a hooks dir
the dirs <worktree>/.gradle-home and <worktree>/.android-shared themselves (contents are gradle's)
<worktree>/app/build and <worktree>/.gradle, owned by the builder (coder_user) so build_app can fix its own outputs; the worktree pass never enters them; 'other' bits are never forced
APKs, AAB and output-metadata.json that build_app names (project.config)
each directory from the worktree down to a deliverable, so it is reachable without group membership
